Sports & Simulation Games

Build teams. Shape careers. Create your own sports history.

Greenbush Games creates detailed browser-based sports management and simulation games built around long-term saves, deep competition systems, and worlds that develop differently every time you play.

🤼

Wrestling Program Dynasty

Take control of a college wrestling program and build it into a national power. Recruit athletes from around the United States and abroad, set your lineup, develop wrestlers over multiple seasons, and guide your team through dual meets, tournaments, conference competition, and the biggest stages in college wrestling.

Your program also extends beyond the college season through its Regional Training Center, where elite wrestlers can continue their careers in freestyle competition. Build a complete wrestling system, develop future champions, and create a dynasty that lasts for generations.

PLAY GAME
🇺🇸

American Patriot Games

Watch athletes representing states, territories, and regions from across the United States compete in a massive multi-event national competition. Every event contributes to the larger battle for individual, men's, women's, and overall team supremacy.

Follow competitors across multiple seasons, watch rivalries and stars emerge, and see which parts of the country become sporting powerhouses. The result is a constantly changing American sports universe where every point can change the national standings.

PLAY GAME
☘️

Gaelic Games Manager

Enter a living world of Gaelic football and hurling spanning every Irish county along with New York and London. Manage the club and county game, develop players from local prospects into stars, choose your panels and lineups, and compete through league and championship seasons.

Club success feeds into provincial and national competition while county teams battle for promotion, championships, and long-term prestige. Football and hurling each have their own histories, rivalries, champions, and evolving competitive landscape.

PLAY GAME
